reviewText: I loved staying here. As someone with respiratory allergies and who has never worn shoes in the house, it was so nice to check into a place that was *impeccably* clean - my bare feet stayed clean all 10 days, and no dust bunnies under or around furniture to give me allergies. Kitchen was well stocked with implements and equipment if you like to cook - less so for bakers - but bring your own knife roll (as with any Airbnb - guests can wear out knives quickly). Supply closet had extras of everything and cleaning supplies so we could easily keep things clean during our stay. A market with great produce within a 2 block walk, Prospect Park, Children's Museum, the subway, and 2 bus lines close by. And Michaelle was super responsive when I needed help (permanent markers for my daughter's things and for a key when my daughter locked herself in the room 🙈). Umbrellas were very useful for surprise showers. Will stay again!
